retailStores.label: NIKE Direct and Converse retail stores
retailStores.definition: Number of NIKE Brand factory stores, in-line stores (including employee-only stores) and Converse stores operated by NIKE Direct and Converse (FY2025 10-K, U.S. and non-U.S. retail store tables).

footwearShare.label: Share of NIKE Brand footwear production
footwearShare.definition: Approximate share of total NIKE Brand footwear finished goods made by contract-manufacturer factories in the country. The 10-K names only the top three countries; factories are independent contractors, not Nike-owned.

apparelShare.label: Share of NIKE Brand apparel production
apparelShare.definition: Approximate share of total NIKE Brand apparel finished goods made by contract-manufacturer factories in the country (top three countries only).

longLivedAssets.label: Long-lived assets
longLivedAssets.definition: Long-lived assets (property, plant and equipment, net and operating lease ROU assets, net) attributable to operations in the country, for the countries Nike names as its largest concentrations.

sites.name: NIKE World Headquarters
sites.description: Owned, approximately 400-acre site with over 40 buildings, occupied by approximately 10,500 employees.

source.quote: The NIKE World Headquarters, owned by NIKE and located near Beaverton, Oregon, USA, is an approximately 400-acre site consisting of over 40 buildings which, together with adjacent leased properties, functions as our global headquarters and is occupied by approximately 10,500 employees

notes: Countries: production shares are for independent contract factories (the 10-K names only the top three countries for footwear and apparel; as of May 31, 2025 contract manufacturers ran 97 footwear factories in 11 countries and 303 apparel factories in 34 countries). Long-lived assets are given only for the U.S., Belgium, China, the U.K. and 'Other'. Retail stores are given only as U.S. versus non-U.S. No employee count by state, country or region was found: the 10-K gives approximately 77,800 employees worldwide, and the FY24 Sustainability Data file has no headcount by geography (the FY25 impact report was not checked). Nike's online manufacturing map (factories and workers by country) was not checked. U.S. revenue ($19,725 million in FY2025) is in the records and not repeated.
